title: Carbon-storage verification: reproducibility package
description: Derived data, source registries, code and provenance supporting the manuscript 'Seismic detectability does not predict public verification across operational CO2 storage projects'. Version 1.0.1 is the Zenodo archival release and contains no scientific or numerical changes relative to v1.0.0; the manuscript title and figure headings were refined after archival release without changing the underlying analyses.
